verdict.rationale: Orama's core library is API/SDK-first (create/insert/search all in-process via code, confirmed by a runtime probe), and Orama Cloud exposes official SDKs (JS/TS, Python, Rust) plus an MCP server for AI-interface access, suggesting most functionality is programmatically accessible. However, no OpenAPI spec was found (404s across candidate paths) and there's no explicit documentation stating full feature parity between the Cloud dashboard/UI and its APIs (e.g., dashboard-only project/config management). missing for 10: a published OpenAPI reference, and explicit confirmation that all UI-configurable settings (data sources, indexing schemas, dashboard analytics) are also exposed via API/SDK.
